think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering. 3) If numeric, check for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just “less/more”. 4) Classify as special only if such sentinel values exist and change semantics; otherwise classify as not special.
